This tree is vendored into Orbspeak as the reference implementation for
bring-your-own-key cloud transcription (OpenAI Whisper / gpt-4o-transcribe),
local Whisper.cpp / NVIDIA Parakeet, and desktop dictation UX patterns.

Secrets (.env) and downloaded binaries (resources/bin, node_modules) were not copied.
